account.name: Brightwave Logistics
account.industry: transportation, logistics, supply chain and storage

dossier.summary: Brightwave Logistics runs regional freight and warehousing across the Midwest, with six distribution sites and about 400 people.
dossier.why_now: Opened two cross-dock sites this year and kept the operations team flat.

data.why_now: Opened two cross-dock sites this year and kept the operations team flat.
data.why_you: Brightwave opened two cross-dock sites this year and kept the operations team flat. Most of this table is trying to do the same thing next year, and I would like them to hear how you did it.

featured_guest.name: Ruth Adeyemi
featured_guest.role: Former COO, a national freight brokerage
featured_guest.bio: She ran operations as the company went from 300 to 1,100 people, and has clear views on which decisions she would make earlier.
